summary: Week 4 produced 7 messages, and every single one of them landed in a 26-hour burst between 8/26 19:17 and 8/27 21:52. The first five and a half days of the window — 8/21, 8/22, 8/23, 8/24, 8/25 and most of 8/26 — were completely silent, extending a dead-chat run that began with Alanna's ignored 8/19 message. Nobody from ALTR spoke to this client for six days and twenty hours. Three things define the week. First, the Aug 24 pinned drop (BGG Brady/Yasmina) passed with zero mention from anyone — that is the second consecutive pinned scene with no in-chat coverage, on the client's #1 stated priority, and Aug 29 (Lola second scene) is now one day out with nothing said about it either. Second, the payment risk flagged last week materialised exactly as predicted: Stephski chased the 8/15 invoice on 8/26 with 'Hi love checking in on this' and Alanna answered 'Yep sorry on it' — confirming the account's first-ever invoice was still unpaid 11 days after issue, and it remains unconfirmed at 13 days. Third, Alanna volunteered customs for the second week running ('Any new customs?', 8/26) and was told 'No new customs' for the second week running — while Ollie's 8/15 promise to 'push heavy' on selling the existing ones has produced no reported result in 13 days. What activity there was came entirely from ALTR chasing its own loose ends: Stephski chasing money, Mayson chasing why his 8/14 domain is unused, Ollie asking a strategy question. Meanwhile the 25-day-old onboarding stack — IG impersonator takedown, chatter FAQ form, Mica's kickoff call — went a fourth consecutive reporting cycle without a single word from anyone, Mica has now sent zero messages in 25 days, and Alanna's 8/19 'stop chatting, I'm live' instruction has been sitting unanswered for 9 days.

health.rationale: Down 7 from 72. The activity in this window was not delivery, it was ALTR chasing its own open loops, and the underlying position got worse in four measurable ways. (1) Payment risk converted from theoretical to real: last week's state said 'if unpaid, this becomes the first late-payment data point' — Stephski's 8/26 chase and Alanna's 'Yep sorry on it' confirm the first invoice went 11 days unpaid and is still unconfirmed at 13. (2) The Aug 24 pinned drop got zero coverage, making two consecutive missed drops on her top priority, with Aug 29 one day away and unaddressed. (3) The client offered customs again on 8/26 and was declined again — two weeks in a row of turning away volunteered supply, with no results from the 8/15 'push heavy' promise to show for it. (4) Her 8/19 live-stream instruction is now 9 days unanswered and the 25-day onboarding items (IG takedown, FAQ form, Mica's call) went untouched for a fourth straight cycle; Mica has produced nothing in 25 days. Not lower because three separate ALTR people did break the silence unprompted on 8/26-8/27, and Ollie's funnel observation about the 32-million-view reel is the first piece of genuine strategic thinking anyone has offered this account. Volume flattened rather than halved this week (10 -> 7 vs 34 -> 19 -> 10), but client messages fell again, 3 -> 2.
